import TransposeFollowup.SeedMultipleMeaning
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def adderHeads : RepeatedAdd.Port → Int
  | .fuel => 43 | .acc => -100 | .factor => 17 | .scratch => 0 | .zero => 200

def addPorts : List RepeatedAdd.Port := [.fuel,.acc,.factor,.scratch,.zero]

def cleanScratch (w : Tape Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (w.left = [.start]) && w.right.all (fun s => decide (s = .blank))

def checkMultiple (K m a x : Nat) : Bool :=
  let initial := RepeatedAdd.ready [true] (bits m a) (bits m x)
  let c := NativeZipper.run (FixedMultiple.program K) (K*(18*m+52)+1)
    (FixedMultiple.zipperCfg (FixedMultiple.start K) initial adderHeads)
  decide (c.core.pc = .done) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .acc = Counter.marked (bits m ((a+K*x)%2^m))) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .factor = Counter.marked (bits m x)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .zero = Counter.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .fuel = Counter.marked [true]) && cleanScratch (c.core.tapes .scratch) &&
    addPorts.all (fun p => decide (c.pos p = adderHeads p))

def seedHeads : ArithmeticSeed.Port → Int
  | .source => -31 | .number => 17 | .zeroA => -100 | .zeroB => 200
  | .one => -7 | .fuel => 43 | .left => 0 | .right => -1024

def seedPorts : List ArithmeticSeed.Port := [.source,.number,.zeroA,.zeroB,.one,.fuel,.left,.right]

def checkSeedMultiple (C K : Nat) (constant : Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let m := 2*xs.length+C
  let v := K*(if constant then 1 else Counter.value xs)
  let c := NativeZipper.run (SeedMultiple.program C K constant)
    (46*xs.length+17*C+83+K*(18*m+52))
    (SeedMultiple.zipperCfg (.seed (.pad false (.init (.erase 0)))) (ArithmeticSeed.initial xs) seedHeads)
  decide (c.core.pc = .multiply .done) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .source = Counter.marked xs) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .number = Counter.marked (xs ++ List.replicate (xs.length+C) false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .zeroA = Counter.marked (bits m (v%2^m))) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .zeroB = Counter.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .one = Counter.marked (true :: List.replicate (m-1) false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .fuel = Counter.marked [true]) &&
    cleanScratch (c.core.tapes .left) && cleanScratch (c.core.tapes .right) &&
    seedPorts.all (fun p => decide (c.pos p = seedHeads p))

def checks : Nat × Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut raw := 0
  let mut integrated := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for seed in List.range 96 do
    let m := seed%8
    let K := (seed/8)%6
    let a := (17*seed+seed/3)%2^m
    let x := (11*seed+seed/7)%2^m
    raw := raw+1
    if !checkMultiple K m a x then failures := failures+1
  for m in [16,32,64] do
    for K in [0,1,3,7] do
      raw := raw+1
      if !checkMultiple K m (2^m-1) (2^m-1) then failures := failures+1
  for l in List.range 4 do
    for n in List.range (2^l) do
      for C in [1,4] do
        for K in [0,1,3] do
          for constant in [false,true] do
            integrated := integrated+1
            if !checkSeedMultiple C K constant (bits l n) then failures := failures+1
  for l in [8,16,32] do
    for n in [0,2^l-1] do
      for constant in [false,true] do
        integrated := integrated+1
        if !checkSeedMultiple 4 3 constant (bits l n) then failures := failures+1
  for n in [0,1] do
    for constant in [false,true] do
      integrated := integrated+1
      if !checkSeedMultiple 0 7 constant (bits 1 n) then failures := failures+1
  return (raw,integrated,failures)
#eval checks
